searchText: I think you kind of answered yourself. There is no reason to promote yourself as former fellow if you haven't contributed. Fellowship is fully open in a way that all contributions are public so anyone can verify your claims so it would be more harmful than productive Yes but it seems like the devrel of nethermind <@761604431284011039> (Aayush Giri) is advertising himself as a protocol fellow even though he has not contributed . Source- https://www.starknet.io/blog/starknet-hacker-house-why-our-mentors-are-your-products-best-friend/ I mean, its possible for them to lie in their resume , and also asking if you condone this? Thanks for pointing this out. He reached out to us before EPF5 but haven't participated at all. In this case, I would ask <@761604431284011039> not to use EPF in his resume doesn’t the billion fellowship count? Ah you were NB Fellows? Next Billion fellowship is something different than protocol fellowship. I understand there might be confusion I think that was a lie too. https://nxbn.ethereum.foundation/fellowship you can see past fellows here. there was my misunderstanding of openness of the program
